topic: Tardigrade (water bear): a tiny animal smaller than 1 mm that can survive freezing, boiling heat, drying out and even being sent into space.

episode.title: Tardigrade: The Tiny Survival Superhero!

shots.narration: Did you know a tiny animal can survive exposure to space?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D scientific visualization of a magnified tardigrade above Earth's curved blue horizon; no text.
shots.action: The compact, dried tardigrade drifts across the foreground.
shots.mood: Bright blue planetary glow, wondrous and exciting.

shots.narration: Meet the tardigrade, a water bear smaller than 1 mm!
shots.scene: Sunny forest clearing, cinematic 3D nature-film style, damp moss beneath a portable microscope without markings.
shots.action: Kiko peers into the microscope beside Pip.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight, emerald greenery, eager discovery.

shots.narration: [excited] Let's peek into its tiny, watery world!
shots.scene: Magnified microscopic water film between moss leaves, a cute but anatomically recognizable tardigrade with eight short legs.
shots.action: The tardigrade crawls along a moss leaf.
shots.mood: Luminous green surroundings, gentle underwater sparkle.

shots.narration: But what happens when its watery home dries out?
shots.scene: The same magnified moss leaf, with a thinning water film surrounding the tardigrade.
shots.action: The water film recedes from the tardigrade.
shots.mood: Soft golden light, curious suspense without danger.

shots.narration: It shrivels into a dormant bundle called a tun.
shots.scene: Extreme microscopic close-up of the tardigrade on the drying moss leaf.
shots.action: The tardigrade contracts into a compact tun with tucked-in legs.

shots.narration: [whispers] In this state, it can survive drying out.
shots.scene: Magnified dry moss landscape, the compact tardigrade tun nestled in a shallow leaf crease.
shots.action: The camera-facing moss leaf sways gently beneath the motionless tun.
shots.mood: Peaceful amber light, patient and resilient.

shots.narration: Add water, and it can become active again!
shots.scene: The same microscopic moss crease, now covered by a fresh clear water film.
shots.action: The rehydrated tardigrade unfolds its short legs.
shots.mood: Fresh green glow, joyful discovery and relief.

shots.narration: Some have even survived exposure to space!
shots.scene: Cinematic 3D scientific visualization of a magnified dried tardigrade against Earth's blue curve and black space.
shots.action: The compact tardigrade rotates slowly in the foreground.
shots.mood: Brilliant blue rim light, triumphant wonder.

shots.narration: [excited] Next, which ocean animal has eight arms? Can you guess?
shots.scene: Sunny tropical shore, turquoise ocean and rounded tide-pool rocks, vertical 9:16 cinematic 3D composition.
shots.action: Kiko points toward a sparkling tide pool beside Pip.

episode.endHook: Which ocean animal has eight arms? Guess our next discovery!
episode.description: Meet the tardigrade, a tiny water bear with extraordinary survival powers! Join Kiko and Pip as drying moss reveals its amazing trick, and discover how some tardigrades have even survived exposure to space.
